description: Mexican customs uses a randomiser - press the button, green or red. Red means full inspection. It is genuinely random, which does not make it cheap when it happens.
energy_note: A red light and two hours.

aspect: Goods brought home are taxed as imports
description: The television, the tools, the things bought to bring back are subject to duty above the traveller allowance - so the savings of working abroad are partly taxed at the door.
energy_note: Taxed on the things he bought to bring home.

description: Cars brought in from the US require permits and deposits, and the regularisation rules change between administrations - so the legality of the car in the driveway is a moving target.
energy_note: A legal car that became illegal by decree.

description: Twenty-two hours of driving, three hundred kilos of tools and gifts, and the button turns red. The inspector is polite and thorough and takes ninety minutes. Nothing is wrong. The television is charged duty because the receipt is in dollars.
energy_note: Ninety minutes, nothing wrong, and duty on the television.
